subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation accept the global browser SSRF opt-in as authority for model-provider HTTP, or only the canonical `models.providers.xai.request` policy?
rationale: Both choices permit private-network egress but create different authorization scopes; repository precedent favors one canonical provider-request policy, and the linked issue already carries product and security decision signals.

options.title: Provider request policy only
options.body: Use sanitized `models.providers.xai.request` through `resolveProviderHttpRequestConfig`, keeping browser navigation policy separate from provider egress.

options.title: Allow both explicit opt-ins
options.body: Treat browser and provider opt-ins as equivalent authority through one shared policy seam with focused precedence and redirect-boundary tests.

options.title: Keep xAI default-deny
options.body: Reject private xAI image endpoints and close the linked issue as an intentional security boundary.

recommendation.title: Provider request policy only
recommendation.body: Use sanitized `models.providers.xai.request` through `resolveProviderHttpRequestConfig`, keeping browser navigation policy separate from provider egress.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sets cross-surface SSRF authorization semantics and requires repository-level product and security intent.
